components/filters/ChipGallery.tsx.name: Visual filter chips

components/filters/CollapsibleSection.ts.name: Collapsible filter group

components/filters/FilterHeaderBar.tsx.description: Sits above the product grid with sort options and a button to open the full filter panel.

components/filters/FiltersDrawer.tsx.description: Slides open a full set of filter options—shape, metal, price and more—from the side of the screen.

components/filters/FilterSections.tsx.description: Organises all available filters into labelled sections such as shape, style, metal and price.

components/filters/LuxuryFilterButton.ts.name: Round filter button
components/filters/LuxuryFilterButton.ts.description: Renders a single circular filter option that highlights when selected.

components/filters/SectionSelectedCount..name: Selected filter count badge
components/filters/SectionSelectedCount..description: Shows a small number next to a filter group name indicating how many options are active.
